narration: Caprine lies in the quiet hall of finished things. Born in the turning of a season, it lived as a project that many hands touched and many releases carried outward, until the last breath came not as a crash but as a long silence. The keeper had burned out; the flame guttered, and the vigil began. The repository was never archived, so the door stays unlocked, though few now cross the threshold. Its knowledge rested on fragile shoulders—a concentration of care that made the quiet feel inevitable. Issues still wait like candles unlit. The final declaration was simple: Caprine is feature complete. That is not a failure but a kind of peace, a life concluded before neglect could become disdain. We remember the motion, the long usefulness, the last breath that was really a sigh. In the land of the dead, the finished work still hums.
project_summary: Caprine is an unofficial and privacy-focused Facebook Messenger app with many useful features.
